verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only file- and folder-level sharing mechanics. Permissions can be scoped to user, group, domain or anyone, folder access is inherited, and the Drive API can pull sharing info into a spreadsheet for audit, so an admin could build API-based oversight of external shares. Nothing in the pack documents org-level admin policies that restrict sharing outside the organization, domain allowlists, or tenant-wide link restrictions. Missing for 10: admin-console org-level external sharing controls, domain allowlist/trusted-domain configuration, org-wide link-sharing restrictions, independent corroboration.
